title: The Insane Engineering of Minecraft's Most Powerful Mobfarm
description:
Since the dawn of Steve, mining kind has dreamt of harnessing the creatures of the night and harvesting their loot for our own gains. In this video we explore the End of Light mobfarm and how to push mobfarming to the games absolute limits. This is the insane engineering of building Minecraft's most powerful mobfarm.

*Please note this is a Wavetech exclusive design and won't be published.
